notes: County site www.bastropvotes.org returns an empty HTTP 202 to the fetch module (bot protection), so check 2 was not possible; all three elections are on Clarity and were settled by check 1. Vote types were read from the cached detail.xml files: the first election-night update of each election has Early Voting/Absentee precinct numbers only; election-day precinct numbers first appear at 11:35 PM (2024 general), 9:58 PM (2026 primary) and 9:12 PM (2026 runoff). Several early versions return 404 (pre-election test versions). In the 2026 runoff the Clarity reporting units are 'Poll 1' to 'Poll 4' (consolidated runoff polling precincts), not the 26 regular precincts. LIVE is applied only when two or more election-night updates carry election-day precinct numbers.
tag_rationale: The 2024 general and the 2026 runoff are both END (election-day precinct numbers in one election-night update), so the tag is PRECINCT_END_OF_NIGHT even though the 2026 primary was LIVE; confidence high because check 1 settled them.

Next version 11/12/2024 5:00:39 PM.
